rules: CS_RANK spreads between two bare fundamentals with no price/volume leg keep failing cheap_screen right at the edge: operating_margin−asset_turnover missed at 0.98, accrual_gap−leverage at 0.95, and a delta-of-rank version of leverage−roa missed harder at 0.59. Pair a fundamental spread with a raw price/volume leg instead of a second fundamental.

Rank each leg before combining, don't rank a raw product: CS_RANK($leverage)*CS_RANK(ABS($return)) was accepted at 2.007, but CS_RANK(TS_DELTA($leverage,63)*TS_STD($return,63)) — a raw product wrapped in one CS_RANK — missed cheap_screen at 0.96. Prefer CS_RANK(a)*CS_RANK(b) over CS_RANK(a*b).

$book_per_share/($close+eps) crossed multiplicatively with a second fundamental's CS_RANK is a closed template: swapping the partner from $roe to $leverage still shared 6 nodes with an archived member. Don't refill that slot with another fundamental — change the combinator or add a real second transform.

ABS(CS_DEMEAN($roe)) crossed with TS_RANK($dollar_volume,63) was only barely accepted at fitness -0.009, while plain CS_RANK($roe) crossed with a volume/price-delta term hit 5.921 (the round's best). Try a fundamental's bare signed rank before its demeaned-magnitude transform when crossing with volume.

TS_DELTA(fundamental,63)*TS_RANK($dollar_volume,w) accepted for $accrual_gap (w=21, fitness 0.708) but failed hard for $operating_margin (w=90, |t| 0.51) — this template doesn't transfer across fundamentals unchecked; validate per field.

6 of this round's 17 rejections (about a third) were exact within-run duplicates of an earlier proposal in the same batch. Dedupe new candidates against everything already proposed this round, not just the archive, before submitting.

CS_RANK($earnings_per_share ratio) − CS_RANK(TS_MEAN($return,w)) tripped archive_subtree from changing w alone (windows 5 and 42 both collided, sharing 6-7 nodes with archived siblings). The TS_MEAN($return,w) leg is saturated at every window tried — pair the eps ratio with a different right-hand transform entirely.

A crossover call failed outright by exceeding the output token cap, burning the round's budget for nothing. Favor crossover parent pairs with smaller combined tree size, or simplify one parent first, rather than pairing two large/deeply nested trees.
